user_raid_experience_20260926.title: User raid tactic for Maloriak (first-hand raid experience), relayed by the coordinator 2026-09-26
user_raid_experience_20260926.publisher: project user (authoritative; outranks guides per the project's tactic policy)
claims: Never interrupt Release Aberrations: let every release through and kill each pack of 3 as it comes, ideally during Green (Debilitating Slime); 10N has 18 in reserve.

Hard switch at 30% (moved to 50% by user_raid_experience_20260927): every DPS stops damaging Maloriak and kills adds until every Aberration is dead and the chambers are empty; phase two starts with 0 Aberrations and only the two Prime Subjects. No DoTs started or refreshed on him during the switch; ticking DoTs are fine. Pets and guardians switch to adds too.
The Blood DK main tank keeps full damage on Maloriak throughout, including the switch (Death Strike keeps him healthy).

Remedy: dispelled above 30% (mage Spellsteal, then Purge, hunter, priest); from 30% until all adds are dead nobody dispels it, so his self-heal offsets the tank's damage and keeps him above 25%; dispelled again once the adds are dead and the reserve is empty.
Hunter Misdirection and rogue Tricks of the Trade on the Feral off-tank, timed for each release.

The Feral off-tank kites the Aberrations, helped by Freeze Trap (only on an add nobody is hitting) and slows (hunter Ice or Frost Trap, shaman Frost Shock); no slow totems (Earthbind would replace the earth buff totem); keep them away from Maloriak because Growth Catalyst (10 yd) also buffs him.
Unchanged: interrupt Arcane Storm; vial mechanics, the tank spot, the line-of-sight formation and the phase-two burn.

Refinement (relayed 2026-09-26): human raids usually reach Green before 30%; bots reach 30% sooner with the reserve still full. Kill adds as they come; if adds are still left at 30%, stop DPS on the boss and kill them one by one; once all are dead, kill the boss and dispel Remedy again. With nothing left at 30% there is no pause.

verbatim_quotes.quote: On normal difficulty, he will either start with Red Vial or Blue Vial, followed by whichever of those he did not use first; after those two he will use Green Vial.
The Red and Blue phases can come in any order, so the cycle is always either of: Blue Phase, Red Phase, then Green Phase; Red Phase, Blue Phase, then Green Phase.
Maloriak will gain Shadow Imbued, making him immune to taunts.

Biting Chill is only cast at raid members in melee range of Maloriak (1 raid member in 10-man difficulty and 2 in 25-man difficulty) and deals Frost damage to the affected player and nearby allies every second for 10 seconds.
30 seconds after Debilitating Slime wears off Maloriak will drink from the cauldron again, starting with Dark Magic if you are on heroic difficulty, or Red or Blue if you are on normal difficulty.
Maloriak will drink a different vial from his cauldron every 40 seconds, gaining different abilities depending on which vial was thrown in the cauldron first.
